description: A scripted control for axes through Harbor: nb on Mock as the agent in the fixture's image, with a toolchain set as a build argument, a README laid into the image's repository, and a stage that applies on one toolchain only. No model.

stages.about: read the README and the toolchain the image was built with
a stage that only makes sense on the newer toolchain

toolchain.about: the toolchain version the image is built with; the customer's, not ours

1.20.note: an older toolchain some users are still on

rewritten.note: the README rewritten to show the --json output

nb-mock.note: nb on the Mock provider, as a Harbor agent in the fixture's image

docs-laid.description: the README in the checkout is the one this configuration's docs value carries
